title: The Messner brothers, Syd Nathan and Jack Pearl
summary: The Messners ran from a shoebox with nominal royalties and publishing grabs; King's Syd Nathan and lawyer Jack Pearl wrote harsh contracts.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Wow. Yeah. Well, anyone else come to mind from the early days?
Oh, well, like I say, you know.
What are the Messner brothers, Eddie and?
Well, the Messners, oh, I think their arithmetic was bad. You know, I have no doubt that their arithmetic was bad. But I don't know, I have no way of proving it. Mm-hmm.
